verdict: 161 leads arrived this period; none have entered your pipeline yet.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta campaign delivered 161 leads at an average cost of $13.17 per lead — a strong volume result. However, the most important finding this period is that none of those leads have moved into your intake pipeline, which is an intake process issue, not an ads issue. Separately, lead efficiency has begun softening in the most recent 7 days: cost per lead rose 11.64% week-over-week while spend held nearly flat, pointing to audience fatigue that we are addressing with a creative refresh. Closing the intake gap and stabilizing ad efficiency are the two priorities heading into next week.
